forecast-as-known.rq:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
# Snapshot-local query. Bind targetAt and forecastTarget; issue time is distinct from forecast horizon.
SELECT ?forecast ?issued ?value WHERE {
  ?forecast a cd:EnergyForecast; cd:forecastTarget ?forecastTarget; cd:issuedAt ?issued; cd:forecastPoint ?point.
  ?point cd:interval ?interval; cd:predictedValue ?value.
  ?interval cd:startsAt ?start; cd:endsAt ?end.
  FILTER(?issued<=?knownAt && ?start<=?targetAt && ?targetAt<?end)
}
ORDER BY DESC(?issued)
